title: Runs, Datasets, And Metrics
summary: qym evaluation work is organized around a run executed against a dataset and scored by one or more metrics.
points: A task function is the code under test.
A dataset provides the evaluation items and expected outputs or metadata.
Metrics turn outputs into comparable signals, whether deterministic or LLM-judged.
A run is the persisted record tying all of that together for local artifacts and platform review.

title: Platform Streaming
summary: The SDK can stream run progress and results into the platform while still saving local artifacts.
points: Streaming is optional. Local execution still works without it.
When enabled, the platform becomes the shared system of record for runs, review, and comparisons.
Uploads and streaming are complementary: direct streaming for live feedback, uploads for deferred ingestion.

title: Review And Analysis Flows
summary: qym separates run execution from review, approval, correction, and AI-assisted analysis so teams can operate collaboratively.
points: Review and approval determine which outcomes become trusted organizational signals.
AI analysis clusters failures and suggests explanations or fixes, but it does not replace human judgment.
